name: sos-my-interview
description: Mock interview practice that runs on your own machine.

scripts.dev: npm run frontend && npm run compile && electron .
scripts.package: npm run frontend && npm run compile && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run frontend && npm run compile && electron-builder

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera shows and records you while you answer interview questions.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The microphone records your answers so they can be transcribed and scored.
